question: do reported earnings and cash reflect economic reality?

earnings_versus_cash.finding: Cash exceeds income. Trailing operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}: trailing net income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.net_income} sits well under operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}. Against the company's own history the ratio has come down from {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2024, but that is because net income multiplied (trailing growth {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct}) faster than cash (trailing growth {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct}), not because cash weakened; fiscal-year accruals over assets were {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets}, the lowest of the filled years, and the trailing figure remains negative. Two earlier years show the other regime, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2023 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} in fiscal 2022, when inventory absorbed cash. For the discrete quarter, operating cash flow derived from the two year-to-date statements is {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.this_quarter} against net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter}; the quarterly accruals cell is empty because the 10-Q prints six months only. Working capital is the thing to explain: trade working capital changed by {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital} over the year (negative means released) while trailing revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}; growth normally absorbs working capital. Its parts: receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change}, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income; net inventory fell {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change}; accounts payable rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change}, which is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct} of net income supplied by suppliers, and MD&A names 'the timing of payments to suppliers' as a source. Articulation: the receivables gap between the balance-sheet change and the cash-flow line is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}, unexplained in my inputs, though the new disclosure of long-term unbilled software-licence receivables is a candidate; the inventory gap is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap} while the trailing non-cash inventory write-down is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}, of the same order, which is why the cash-flow line shows an inventory increase of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change} as the net balance fell; the payables line is not tagged, so no gap can be tested there. Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: income moves far less than cash. The quarterly cash series swings from {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.7} to {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2}, which reads as working-capital volatility in a hardware business rather than a smoothed income line, but it means one quarter's cash figure, good or bad, proves little on its own.
earnings_versus_cash.verdict: cash-backed earnings; trailing operating cash flow exceeds net income by a wide margin, but a working-capital release led by supplier payables flatters it and is a timing effect rather than a repeatable source

revenue_recognition.finding: Receivables are not outrunning revenue: period-end days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest of the six filled quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} at the top of the filed history; the trailing average-balance measure is {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}; receivables over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, also the lowest. The release's own 'Average days' sales outstanding (DSOs) were 71.' is higher than the period-end figure because it is an average over the quarter; its method is not in my inputs, so the two are not reconciled, but the direction MD&A claims ('improved cash collections') is the direction the trend shows. Contract liabilities: the current balance is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities} a year earlier, so deferred revenue rose in dollars, while its ratio to quarterly revenue fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, the lowest of the six quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}; revenue grew faster than deferred revenue, which is the mild form of the signal, not a draw-down. Policy and judgment areas carry three changes. First, a new sentence: 'long-term accounts receivable represent unbilled receivables attributable to non-cancellable software licenses recognized as revenue when made available to customers, to be billed in the future.' Revenue recognized at availability and billed later is an extended-terms arrangement by construction; the long-term balance is not in my inputs. Second, all four disaggregation tables relabel 'Products and services transferred over time' as 'Services transferred over time' with no explanation, asserting that no product revenue is recognized over time even though the Platform Software and Services segment reports its software portion as product revenue; with the first change it points to point-in-time treatment of software licences. Third, the remaining-performance-obligation paragraph drops the prior 10-Q's specific percentage expected within twelve months in favour of the majority 'will be satisfied within a year and any remaining performance obligations are typically recognized within three years', and adds 'The timing of fulfillment of remaining performance obligations can be impacted by supply conditions.' Backlog itself rose across the last three prints. The ten-percent customer table now holds only two cloud providers, the service provider row reading 'n/a*'. Fourth-quarter concentration cannot be tested: the record has no fourth-quarter cells. No bill-and-hold language is in my inputs.
revenue_recognition.verdict: no sign of pulled-forward revenue in the receivable and deferred-revenue numbers; three unexplained wording changes around software-licence recognition, over-time classification and backlog conversion lower confidence in the policy, not the numbers

estimates_and_reserves.finding: Allowance for doubtful accounts: the ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}, third lowest of the six quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} last quarter, which was the highest; the dollar allowance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance} a year earlier. A one-quarter slip, small, with the allowance higher in dollars than a year ago; the annual and quarterly series rest on different tags, so the two histories are not strictly comparable. Inventory reserve: the ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}, the highest of the six quarters and above every filed year ({trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} at the last year-end), rising in every printed period from {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}; the balance is {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve}; the six-month provision is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.prior_year_to_date}, and trailing {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}. This is a reserve building, not thinning, so it depresses rather than lifts income; what it does is sit oddly beside a filing that describes demand as unprecedented, and it is charged before a gross margin that still reached {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of the six quarters. Warranty: the ratio is not computable because the accrual is tagged under a concept the lookup does not search; from the printed rollforward the six-month provision exceeds settlements and the accrual rose over the half-year and against a year earlier, so this reserve is also building. Goodwill: the Blue Planet segment carries allocated goodwill, printed unchanged at both dates, while its segment measure turned to a loss this quarter and for six months, its revenue fell and its research spending rose; no impairment-indicator discussion is in my inputs, and MD&A's six-month bullet for the segment gives neither an amount nor a direction word. Discount-rate and growth assumptions are not in a 10-Q. Tax: the trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} on pre-tax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income} and tax of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}; the note attributes the lower rate 'primarily due to an income tax benefit for share-based compensation expense and a change in mix of earnings in jurisdictions with lower tax rates', and a new sentence says such deductions 'can increase or decrease the effective tax rate in the period in which they vest'. That benefit depends on the share price at vesting, not on operations; its dollar amount is not in the calculator, so no earnings adjustment can be sized. The non-GAAP provision separately 'utilizes a current, blended U.S. and foreign statutory annual tax rate of 20% for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 and 22% for the second quarter of fiscal 2025', which lifts adjusted EPS by construction. Accrued income taxes fell sharply over the half-year while cash taxes paid exceeded the six-month provision, a timing item. No valuation-allowance release and no other estimate change raising income appears in my inputs.
estimates_and_reserves.verdict: reserves are building, not thinning, so no income is being drawn from them; the estimate that lifted earnings is the tax rate, driven by a share-based deduction the company itself calls volatile, and the Blue Planet goodwill is the estimate with no visible support

cost_deferral.finding: Capitalized development cost: no CapitalizedComputerSoftwareAdditions is tagged, so no capitalized-over-expensed ratio exists; research and development expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} for six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date}, all expensed as far as the record shows, and capitalized share-based compensation for the current quarter is printed as zero. Soft assets: the share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, third lowest of the six quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} last quarter but below {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share} a year earlier; the quarter's rise coincides with long-term investments growing on the 8-K balance sheet, not with intangibles. Capital spending rose sharply: {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} for six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}, 'primarily for supply chain equipment and research and development'; net equipment is {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment}; trailing capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}. That is capitalization of real assets, not deferral of operating cost, but it raises the depreciation base and lowers free cash flow. Non-recurring items that recur: restructuring is excluded from every adjusted measure and a restructuring rollforward is printed for both the current and the comparative period, MD&A calling it 'relatively unchanged'; a new exclusion, 'Holdback arrangement', is 'a one-time holdback of a portion of the merger consideration otherwise payable at closing to certain key employee shareholders of Nubis Communications, Inc. who became employees of Ciena, which is treated as contingent compensation for GAAP reporting purposes.' Contingent compensation is expensed over the service period, so a 'one-time' label on it will recur in adjusted results until the holdback vests, and it is pay for work. Non-GAAP to GAAP gap: no tagged non-GAAP figure exists, so the trend cell is empty; the release prints 'GAAP net income of 218,220 and adjusted net income of 240,199 (thousands), against 8,969 and 60,657', with adjustments for share-based compensation, amortization of intangibles, restructuring, the holdback and a non-GAAP tax provision. In those printed pairs the adjusted figure sits closer to GAAP than a year ago, so the gap is not widening; share-based compensation, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} trailing, remains the largest add-back and is a real cost.
cost_deferral.verdict: no cost deferral found in the balance sheet; the deferral is in the adjusted presentation, where recurring restructuring and a 'one-time' contingent-compensation charge are excluded, though the GAAP-to-adjusted gap is not widening

cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.finding: Receivables factoring: no proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables concept is tagged in any period and no factoring language is in my inputs; nothing found, which is absence from the record, not proof of absence. Supplier finance: no supplier-finance-programme obligation is tagged and no programme is described; nothing found. Classification shifting: refundable cash advances to a contract manufacturer sit in prepaid expenses within operating cash flow, so they depress rather than lift it; capital purchases 'primarily for supply chain equipment and research and development' sit in investing, where equipment belongs even if placed at manufacturing partners; the discrete-quarter operating cash flow is not printed, and the six-month figure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow.parts.prior_year_to_date}. Purchase obligations are the finding: {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} now against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, and the numbers reader prints the prior 10-Q and 10-K values as lower still, so most of the rise landed in one quarter; that is against net inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} and trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}. The note says Ciena may cancel, reschedule or adjust 'a portion of these orders', leaving the rest firm; MD&A says the opposite, 'only a portion of this amount relates to firm, non-cancelable and unconditional obligations.' Both cannot be the operative description, and neither sizes the firm portion. Leases are small: {terms.balances_now.operating_lease_liability} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.operating_lease_liability}. Guarantees: no maximum-exposure concept is tagged; nothing found. Variable-interest entities: nothing in my inputs. Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} trailing, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.parts.this_year_to_date} for six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.parts.prior_year_to_date}; it is already subtracted, with acquisitions of {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}, in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted} against simple free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple}. Its cash form shows in financing: tax-withholding payments on vested awards for six months printed in the 8-K as '(179,420) against (42,266) (thousands)', beside repurchase-programme cash; trailing repurchases are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}, and repurchases continued after quarter end. The one item I adjust is the payables build described under earnings versus cash.
cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh.verdict: no factoring, supplier finance or classification lift is visible; the off-balance-sheet exposure is a purchase-commitment book that jumped in one quarter and is described inconsistently, and share-based compensation is a large real cost whose cash form sits in financing

controls_audit_and_filing_signals.finding: Auditor: a 10-Q carries no audit opinion and no auditor change is in my inputs; nothing found. Material weakness: Item 4 concludes disclosure controls are effective and reports no change in internal control over financial reporting; nothing found. Critical audit matters: none in a 10-Q. Officer departures: none; the one officer item is the chief financial officer's adoption of a 'Rule 10b5-1 trading arrangement' for 'Sales' running into fiscal 2027, covering a share of net after-tax shares from vesting, a selling plan rather than a departure, noted because it was adopted in the quarter of record results. Late filings and amendments: none on record. Quiet restatement: the numbers reader found no concept and period that a later filing prints at a different value; nothing found. Tagging and cross-document signals, each small: the bad-debt allowance rests on one concept in annual cells and another in quarterly cells; the six-month inventory write-down is printed twice in one filing at two precisions; the segment profit measure is tagged NetIncomeLoss, so the operating-segments total dwarfs consolidated net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} unless a reader filters the consolidation axis; and the year-ago quarter's share-based compensation differs between the 10-Q and the 8-K appendix, with the 10-Q printing a small capitalized share-based amount for that quarter that may be the reconciling item. I compute nothing. Disclosure dropped: the prior 10-Q's subsequent-events note disclosed that 'a portion of the tariffs that Ciena has been subject to were invalid' and the open questions on refunds; this 10-Q says nothing about the ruling, a refund receivable or the replacement tariff in any paragraph in my inputs. Related parties, subsidiary-list changes and SEC comment letters: not in my inputs; nothing found.
controls_audit_and_filing_signals.verdict: clean on the hard signals — no auditor change, weakness, restatement, late filing or officer departure; a cluster of small tagging inconsistencies, one dropped tariff-refund disclosure and a CFO selling plan are the soft ones

cross_document_reconciliation.finding: Of the twenty-one notes items that carry a direction, the numbers confirm sixteen, contradict none and leave five unresolved for want of a number at the right grain (product-line revenue, services margin, the manufacturing-efficiency offset, Netherlands cloud sales, prepaid advances). The 8-K release and the 10-Q agree on quarterly revenue, six-month operating cash flow, net income, current-quarter share-based compensation, deferred revenue, the inventory provision and the warranty provision; they disagree on one prior-year figure, share-based compensation for the year-ago quarter. Two prose-versus-prose disagreements stand: the tax explanation — the note says the rate fell 'primarily due to an income tax benefit for share-based compensation expense and a change in mix of earnings in jurisdictions with lower tax rates' while MD&A says 'Provision for income taxes increased by $2.8 million, primarily due to the increase in pre-tax book income.' — and the cancellable share of purchase commitments, which the note and MD&A assign to opposite portions. One prose tension the numbers cannot settle: the inventory note's 'reductions in forecasted demand for certain products' against MD&A's 'orders for our products and services significantly exceeding our revenue' and 'historically high backlog'; the record shows both a record reserve ratio of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} and a record gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}. The release's average DSO and the trend table's period-end DSO of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} differ in method and are not reconciled, but point the same way.
cross_document_reconciliation.verdict: numbers and prose largely agree; the disagreements are between the company's own documents — tax explanation, cancellable commitments, demand narrative — not between the prose and the numbers

industry_lens.finding: Inventory obsolescence: recognized, not hidden. The reserve ratio is the highest of the filed history at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}, the six-month provision is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.prior_year_to_date}, and days sales of inventory fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the lowest of six quarters (trailing average-balance measure {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_of_inventory}). The anomaly is the cause given, 'reductions in forecasted demand for certain products', in a filing that also builds 'finished good inventory to mitigate supply chain volatility' and describes orders 'significantly exceeding our revenue'; which products are losing demand is not in my inputs. Purchase commitments in excess of need: {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} of commitments against {terms.balances_now.inventory} of net inventory and {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue} of trailing cost of revenue, up from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, with the two documents disagreeing on how much is cancellable; guided growth and rising backlog argue the orders are needed, but if the 'certain products' losing demand are among those ordered, the commitments become the next reserve. Customer concentration: 'Two customers represented 10%-plus of revenue for a total of 34.0% of revenue.', both cloud providers; the ten-percent table's service provider row is 'n/a*' for fiscal 2026; the fiscal-year receivable-concentration facts put the largest customer at {concentration.facts.2} of receivables against {concentration.facts.0} a year earlier and the second at {concentration.facts.3} against {concentration.facts.1}. Channel stuffing: nothing found — receivables grew slower than revenue, period-end DSO is the lowest of the history, deferred revenue rose in dollars and backlog rose; the one place revenue precedes billing is the long-term unbilled software-licence receivable, whose balance is not in my inputs. Circular or vendor-financed deals: nothing found — no investment in a customer is described; long-term investments rose sharply over the half-year on the 8-K balance sheet, and the notes reader lists an available-for-sale securities table, which points to marketable securities rather than customer equity; the composition is not in my inputs. The refundable advances to a contract manufacturer run the other way, from the company to its supplier.
industry_lens.verdict: obsolescence is being expensed and no stuffing or circular dealing is visible; the industry risks that remain open are a purchase-commitment book near a year of cost of revenue, two cloud customers carrying a third of revenue, and a demand-loss reserve cause that the growth narrative does not explain

reconciliation.why: The reserve ratio is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}, the highest of the six filled quarters, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}; the balance is {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve} a year earlier; the six-month provision is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.prior_year_to_date}.

The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}, and the numbers reader's printed pairs — 'The GAAP provision for income taxes is 12,840 on income before income taxes of 231,060 for Q2 2026, against 10,047 on 19,016 a year earlier' — show the rate fell without any computation on my part.

Purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier, and the numbers reader prints the prior 10-Q and 10-K values as lower still.

Remaining performance obligations rose across the last three prints (10-K, prior 10-Q, this 10-Q) per the numbers reader; the calculator carries no backlog field, so the direction rests on the printed values.

The quarter's ten-percent customers are two cloud providers at 'a total of 34.0% of revenue', the service provider having dropped out, and the fiscal-year receivable-concentration facts put the largest customer at {concentration.facts.2} against {concentration.facts.0} a year earlier. A quarterly revenue-share history is not in my inputs, so the confirmation rests on those two points.

Gross margin is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of the six filled quarters, against {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.gross_margin|pct} a year earlier; the split between cost, pricing and mix is not in the record.

Product cost of goods sold is not broken out in the record; total gross margin rose to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, so the offset did not dominate, but its size cannot be seen.
No services gross margin is in the calculator or the numbers report; only total gross margin ({ratios.profitability.gross_margin|pct} trailing) is carried.
The numbers reader prints Blue Planet segment revenue lower than a year earlier for both the quarter and the six months.

The segment measure is a loss for the quarter and the six months against profits a year earlier, segment research and development is higher, and segment gross profit is lower, as the numbers reader prints them.
No country- or customer-level revenue for the Netherlands is in the calculator or the numbers report.

Routing and Switching is a product line inside Networking Platforms; the numbers reader prints the parent segment's revenue higher than a year earlier, but the product line itself is not in the record.

Research and development expense is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} for six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.prior_year_to_date}; acquisition cash in the prior fiscal year is {terms.cash_flow_families.acquisitions}.

Amortization of intangible assets is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization.parts.this_year_to_date.parts.1} for six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.depreciation_and_amortization.parts.prior_year_to_date.parts.1}; the tagged concept covers both lines, so the release's cost-of-goods line is inside it.

Capital expenditure is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} for six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}, and net equipment is {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment}.

Receivables rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} year over year and the six-month cash-flow line shows an increase of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_receivables.parts.this_year_to_date}, while period-end days sales outstanding fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest of six quarters — volume up, collections faster, as the prose says.

The six-month cash-flow inventory line shows an increase of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date} and the numbers reader prints gross inventory higher than at year-end, so a build absorbed cash; net inventory nonetheless fell because the reserve rose to {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve}. The build is confirmed at the gross level, with the reserve taking the net balance down.
No prepaid-expenses balance or contract-manufacturer advance is in the calculator or the numbers report.

The numbers reader prints accrued salaries and total accrued liabilities well below the year-end balances, matching the incentive payout; accounts payable is {terms.balances_now.accounts_payable} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.accounts_payable} a year earlier, matching supplier timing as an offset. The cash-flow payables line is not tagged, so the year-end payables balance is not in the record.

Quarterly revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.year_over_year|pct} year over year and trailing revenue {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, a trajectory consistent with the raised guidance; the guidance it replaced is not in my inputs.

Period-end days sales outstanding is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}, the lowest of six quarters, down from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} last quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} a year earlier; the release's average-method figure is not reconciled to it, but the direction the prose claims is the direction the trend shows.

anomalies.name: Trade working capital released cash during a revenue surge
anomalies.name_ko: 매출 급증 중 운전자본이 현금을 방출
anomalies.what: Trade working capital changed by {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.inputs.change_in_trade_working_capital} over the year (now {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.now}, a year earlier {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_to_firm.trade_working_capital.a_year_earlier}) while trailing revenue grew {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct}. Growth normally absorbs working capital; here payables, a reserve-driven inventory decline and faster collections released it, which flatters trailing operating cash flow of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.operating_cash_flow}.

anomalies.name: Payables build supplies a large share of net income in cash
anomalies.name_ko: 매입채무 증가가 순이익의 큰 몫에 해당하는 현금을 공급
anomalies.what: Accounts payable rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} year over year, {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct} of trailing net income, to {terms.balances_now.accounts_payable} from {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.accounts_payable}; days payable outstanding is {ratios.efficiency.days_payables_outstanding}. MD&A names 'the timing of payments to suppliers' as a source of cash. The cash-flow statement's payables line is not tagged, so the balance-sheet change cannot be tested against it. Part of the rise is purchasing volume behind the revenue growth; the timing part reverses, and the whole field is applied as an adjustment because no portion can be taken.

anomalies.name: Inventory articulation gap matches the non-cash write-down
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 대조 차이가 비현금 평가손과 일치
anomalies.what: The balance-sheet change in net inventory is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.balance_sheet_change} while the cash-flow statement's inventory line is {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.cash_flow_statement_change}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.inventory.articulation_gap}. The trailing non-cash excess-and-obsolescence provision is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down}, of the same order: gross inventory rose and absorbed cash while the reserve took the net balance down. Benign as articulation; the size of the provision is the finding elsewhere.

anomalies.name: Receivables articulation gap without an explanation in the record
anomalies.name_ko: 설명되지 않은 매출채권 대조 차이
anomalies.what: Receivables on the balance sheet rose {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.balance_sheet_change} while the cash-flow line shows {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.cash_flow_statement_change}, a gap of {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.receivables.articulation_gap}: the cash-flow line absorbed more cash than the current balance grew. The new disclosure that 'long-term accounts receivable represent unbilled receivables attributable to non-cancellable software licenses' is a candidate, since the cash-flow line would carry long-term receivables the current balance omits, but that balance is not in my inputs.

anomalies.name: Net income moves far less than operating cash flow
anomalies.name_ko: 순이익 변동이 영업현금흐름 변동보다 훨씬 작음
anomalies.what: Smoothness is {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness}: quarter-to-quarter changes in net income are a fraction of those in operating cash flow. The quarterly cash series runs from {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.7} to {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.operating_cash_flow.2}, while net income moved from {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.8} to {earnings_versus_cash.smoothness.net_income.0}. This reads as working-capital volatility in a hardware business rather than a managed income line, but it means the cash side is the noisy one and a single quarter of cash conversion proves little.

anomalies.name: Cash conversion ratio below the last two fiscal years
anomalies.name_ko: 현금전환비율이 최근 두 회계연도보다 낮음
anomalies.what: Trailing operating cash flow over net income is {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} against {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for fiscal 2025 and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} for fiscal 2024, and accruals over average assets are {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets} against {trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.accruals_over_total_assets} at fiscal year-end. The fall is on a surging denominator — trailing net income growth is {ratios.growth.net_income.trailing_four_quarters|pct}, operating cash flow growth {ratios.growth.operating_cash_flow.trailing_four_quarters|pct} — and both ratios still say cash exceeds income. Fiscal 2023 and fiscal 2022 show the other regime ({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.2.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income} and {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.3.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}), when inventory absorbed cash.

anomalies.name: Over-time revenue row relabelled from products and services to services only
anomalies.name_ko: 기간 인식 매출 행이 설명 없이 '서비스'로만 변경
anomalies.what: All four disaggregation tables relabel 'Products and services transferred over time' as 'Services transferred over time' and drop the segment header row, with no explanation. The new label asserts that no product revenue is recognized over time, while the Platform Software and Services segment reports its software portion as product revenue. A presentation change touching timing of recognition, left unexplained, is a policy signal even where amounts did not move.

anomalies.name: New disclosure of long-term unbilled software-licence receivables
anomalies.name_ko: 장기 미청구 소프트웨어 라이선스 매출채권 신규 공시
anomalies.what: New sentence: 'long-term accounts receivable represent unbilled receivables attributable to non-cancellable software licenses recognized as revenue when made available to customers, to be billed in the future.' Revenue is recognized at availability and billed later — extended terms by construction. The long-term balance is not in the calculator; current receivables are {terms.balances_now.receivables}. No adjustment can be sized.

anomalies.name: Backlog conversion language loosened as backlog grows
anomalies.name_ko: 수주잔고 증가 속 전환 시점 문구 완화
anomalies.what: The remaining-performance-obligation paragraph drops the prior 10-Q's specific percentage expected within twelve months and now says only that the majority 'will be satisfied within a year and any remaining performance obligations are typically recognized within three years', adding that 'The timing of fulfillment of remaining performance obligations can be impacted by supply conditions.' Backlog rose across the last three prints per the numbers reader. Looser conversion language on a larger backlog lowers the information content of the backlog figure.

anomalies.name: Deferred revenue ratio at a low while the balance rises
anomalies.name_ko: 이연수익 비율은 최저인데 잔액은 증가
anomalies.what: Current contract liabilities over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue}, the lowest of six quarters, from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} last quarter and {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.contract_liabilities_over_revenue} a year ago; the balance itself is {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}, and the 8-K shows long-term deferred revenue rising too. Deferred revenue is growing more slowly than revenue, which is the mild form of the signal, not a draw-down.

anomalies.name: Service provider drops out of the ten-percent customer table
anomalies.name_ko: 통신사업자 고객이 10% 고객 표에서 사라짐
anomalies.what: The ten-percent customer table names only 'Cloud provider A' and 'Cloud provider B' for fiscal 2026 and shows 'n/a*' for the service provider that was a ten-percent customer a year ago and in the prior quarter's table. The release states the two at 'a total of 34.0% of revenue'. The customer base behind the record quarter is narrower than a year ago.

anomalies.name: Inventory reserve ratio at the highest point of the filed history
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 평가충당금 비율이 공시 이력상 최고
anomalies.what: Inventory reserve over net inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}, highest of six quarters and above every filed year ({trend_table.years-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} at the last year-end, {trend_table.years-back-3.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} three years back); every printed change is positive. Balance {terms.balances_now.inventory_reserve} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.inventory_reserve}; six-month provision {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.prior_year_to_date}. Building, not thinning — it lowers reported gross margin, which nonetheless reached {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, the highest of the six quarters.

anomalies.name: Bad-debt allowance ratio slips from highest to third lowest in one quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 대손충당금 비율이 한 분기 만에 최고에서 하위권으로
anomalies.what: The allowance ratio fell to {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio} from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.bad_debt_reserve_ratio}, the highest of the six quarters, to third lowest; the dollar allowance is {terms.balances_now.bad_debt_allowance} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.bad_debt_allowance}. With receivables concentrated in two cloud customers the allowance's thinness is more about counterparty size than delinquency. Small, and the quarterly and annual series rest on different tags.

anomalies.name: Effective tax rate lowered by a share-based compensation deduction
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상 세금공제로 낮아진 실효세율
anomalies.what: The trailing effective rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct} on pre-tax income of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.pretax_income} and tax of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense}. The note says the fall was 'primarily due to an income tax benefit for share-based compensation expense and a change in mix of earnings in jurisdictions with lower tax rates', and adds that such deductions 'can increase or decrease the effective tax rate in the period in which they vest'. A benefit valued at the share price at vesting is not operating income; its size is not in the calculator, so it is flagged, not adjusted.

anomalies.name: Non-GAAP tax rate lowered year over year
anomalies.name_ko: 비GAAP 세율 하향
anomalies.what: The release 'utilizes a current, blended U.S. and foreign statutory annual tax rate of 20% for the second quarter of fiscal 2026 and 22% for the second quarter of fiscal 2025'. A lower assumed rate lifts adjusted net income and adjusted EPS irrespective of operations; the release says the rate may change.

anomalies.name: Blue Planet goodwill unchanged while the segment turns to losses
anomalies.name_ko: Blue Planet 부문 손실 전환에도 영업권은 그대로
anomalies.what: The Blue Planet segment measure is a loss this quarter and for six months against profits a year earlier, its revenue fell, and its research and development rose, while allocated goodwill is printed unchanged at both dates. MD&A gives no amount or direction word for the segment in the six-month bullet, and no text discusses impairment indicators. Goodwill headroom for this reporting unit is the estimate to watch; the amounts are in the numbers report, not the calculator.

anomalies.name: Warranty reserve building; ratio not computable from the tags
anomalies.name_ko: 보증충당부채 적립 중이나 태그로는 비율 산출 불가
anomalies.what: The warranty ratio cannot be computed because the accrual is tagged under a concept the lookup does not search. From the printed rollforward, the six-month provision exceeds settlements and the accrual is higher than at year-end and a year earlier; the provision also runs well above the prior year's. Building, not thinning — a cost signal rather than an income lift.

anomalies.name: Accrued income taxes fall to a small fraction of year-end
anomalies.name_ko: 미지급 법인세가 연말 대비 급감
anomalies.what: Accrued income taxes fell from the year-end balance to a small fraction of it while the six-month GAAP provision is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.income_tax_expense.parts.this_year_to_date} and the 8-K prints cash taxes paid above that. Cash paid ahead of the provision explains the fall; noted as a change from the company's past, not as an income effect.

anomalies.name: 'One-time' holdback is contingent compensation that recurs
anomalies.name_ko: '일회성' 홀드백은 반복되는 조건부 보상
anomalies.what: A new non-GAAP exclusion, 'Holdback arrangement', appears this quarter with a dash a year ago. The release calls it 'a one-time holdback of a portion of the merger consideration otherwise payable at closing to certain key employee shareholders of Nubis Communications, Inc. who became employees of Ciena, which is treated as contingent compensation for GAAP reporting purposes.' Contingent compensation is expensed over the service period, so this 'one-time' item recurs in adjusted results until it vests; it is pay for work and belongs in cost.

anomalies.name: Restructuring excluded from adjusted results in every period
anomalies.name_ko: 매 기간 조정 실적에서 제외되는 구조조정비
anomalies.what: Restructuring is excluded from every adjusted measure in the release, a restructuring rollforward is printed for both the current and the comparative period, and MD&A calls the charge 'relatively unchanged'. A charge that appears in every period is an operating cost; the amounts are not in the calculator.

anomalies.name: Capital spending rises sharply for supply-chain equipment
anomalies.name_ko: 공급망 설비 투자 급증
anomalies.what: Six-month capital purchases are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}; trailing {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure} against {terms.trailing_four_quarters_a_year_earlier.capital_expenditure}; net equipment {terms.balances_now.property_plant_and_equipment} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.property_plant_and_equipment}. MD&A: 'primarily for supply chain equipment and research and development'. Real assets, but a rising capital base lowers free cash flow ({free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_simple} trailing) and raises future depreciation.

anomalies.name: Soft-asset share rises in the quarter on long-term investments
anomalies.name_ko: 장기투자 증가로 분기 중 무형·기타자산 비중 상승
anomalies.what: Soft-asset share is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share}, up from {trend_table.quarters-back-1.ratios.soft_asset_share} last quarter, still below {trend_table.quarters-back-4.ratios.soft_asset_share} a year earlier and {trend_table.quarters-back-7.ratios.soft_asset_share} at the top of the history. The quarter's rise tracks long-term investments growing on the 8-K balance sheet, not intangibles; no capitalized development cost is tagged.

anomalies.name: Purchase obligations jump in a single quarter
anomalies.name_ko: 구매약정이 한 분기 만에 급증
anomalies.what: Purchase obligations are {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations} a year earlier; the numbers reader prints the prior quarter's and year-end's values as lower, so most of the rise landed this quarter. Against net inventory {terms.balances_now.inventory} and trailing cost of revenue {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}, the commitments approach a year of purchases. MD&A names this as the one contractual obligation that changed materially; the note ties it to 'advanced orders for long lead time components' in a constrained supply environment.

anomalies.name: Note and MD&A describe the cancellable portion of commitments oppositely
anomalies.name_ko: 주석과 MD&A가 구매약정 취소 가능 비중을 반대로 서술
anomalies.what: The note says Ciena may cancel, reschedule or adjust 'a portion of these orders', leaving the rest firm; MD&A says 'only a portion of this amount relates to firm, non-cancelable and unconditional obligations.' The two documents assign the firm and cancellable labels to opposite portions, and neither sizes the firm part of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}. The numbers cannot settle a prose-versus-prose conflict.

anomalies.name: Share-based compensation and its cash shadow in financing
anomalies.name_ko: 주식보상과 재무활동에 숨은 현금 유출
anomalies.what: Share-based compensation is {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation} trailing, {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.parts.this_year_to_date} for six months against {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation.parts.prior_year_to_date}; it is added back in every adjusted measure and already subtracted in quality-adjusted free cash flow of {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}. Its cash form sits in financing: tax-withholding payments on vested awards printed as '(179,420) against (42,266) (thousands)' for six months, beside repurchase-programme cash; trailing repurchases are {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_repurchases}, and the diluted share count rose year over year. Dilution is bought back with cash the operating statement never shows.

anomalies.name: No factoring, supplier finance or guarantee concept tagged
anomalies.name_ko: 매출채권 매각·공급망금융·보증 태그 없음
anomalies.what: No proceeds-from-sale-of-receivables, supplier-finance obligation or guarantee-maximum-exposure concept is tagged in any period, and no such programme is described in my inputs. Nothing found; the record's silence is not the filing's, and a programme stated only in text would be invisible here.

anomalies.name: Refundable cash advances placed with a contract manufacturer
anomalies.name_ko: 위탁제조사에 맡긴 환급 가능 선급금
anomalies.what: MD&A attributes the prepaid change to 'higher refundable cash advances to a third-party contract manufacturer and higher prepaid value-added tax (VAT)'. These sit in operating cash flow and depress it, so no lift; they are, however, company cash placed with a supplier, and the amount is not in the calculator.

anomalies.name: Year-ago share-based compensation differs between the 10-Q and the 8-K
anomalies.name_ko: 전년 동기 주식보상 금액이 10-Q와 8-K에서 불일치
anomalies.what: For the year-ago quarter the 10-Q's share-based compensation fact and the 8-K appendix's add-back differ by a small amount; the current quarter agrees in both. The 10-Q prints a small capitalized share-based compensation amount for that year-ago quarter, a plausible reconciling item; I compute nothing.

anomalies.name: Bad-debt allowance tagged under different concepts in annual and quarterly cells
anomalies.name_ko: 대손충당금 태그가 연간과 분기에서 다름
anomalies.what: Annual allowance cells rest on AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivableCurrent and quarterly cells on AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivable. The two series of the same ratio are not strictly comparable.

anomalies.name: Inventory write-down tagged twice at two precisions in one filing
anomalies.name_ko: 재고 평가손이 한 공시에서 두 정밀도로 중복 태그
anomalies.what: The six-month inventory write-down is tagged twice in one filing under the same paragraph at two precisions. Not a restatement; a tagging inconsistency.

anomalies.name: Segment profit measure tagged as NetIncomeLoss
anomalies.name_ko: 부문 이익 지표가 NetIncomeLoss로 태그됨
anomalies.what: The segment profit measure is tagged NetIncomeLoss, so the operating-segments total dwarfs consolidated net income of {ratios.growth.net_income.this_quarter} unless a reader filters on the consolidation axis. Whether earlier filings tagged it the same way is not in my inputs.

anomalies.name: Tariff ruling and refund disclosure dropped without follow-up
anomalies.name_ko: 관세 판결·환급 공시가 후속 설명 없이 사라짐
anomalies.what: The prior 10-Q disclosed that 'a portion of the tariffs that Ciena has been subject to were invalid' and the open questions on refunds; this 10-Q carries nothing on the ruling, a refund receivable or the replacement tariff in any paragraph in my inputs. A possible asset (a refund) and a cost driver (a replacement tariff) have gone silent.

anomalies.name: Chief financial officer adopts a selling plan in the quarter
anomalies.name_ko: CFO가 분기 중 주식 매도 계획 채택
anomalies.what: The CFO adopted a 'Rule 10b5-1 trading arrangement' for 'Sales' in the quarter, covering a share of net after-tax shares from restricted stock unit vesting and performance units. A standard plan, noted because it was adopted in the quarter of record results and a guidance raise.

anomalies.name: MD&A tax explanation omits the share-based benefit the note names
anomalies.name_ko: MD&A 세금 설명이 주석의 주식보상 혜택을 누락
anomalies.what: MD&A: 'Provision for income taxes increased by $2.8 million, primarily due to the increase in pre-tax book income.' The note: the rate fell 'primarily due to an income tax benefit for share-based compensation expense and a change in mix of earnings in jurisdictions with lower tax rates'. Both are true of different things — the dollar provision rose, the rate fell — but MD&A omits the driver that matters for earnings quality; the trailing rate is {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}.

anomalies.name: Reserve cause of falling demand against a narrative of unprecedented demand
anomalies.name_ko: 수요 감소라는 충당금 사유와 전례 없는 수요 서술의 충돌
anomalies.what: The inventory note attributes the provision to 'reductions in forecasted demand for certain products'; MD&A describes 'orders for our products and services significantly exceeding our revenue' and 'historically high backlog'. The numbers support both — gross margin of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.gross_margin|pct}, days of inventory of {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, rising backlog, and the highest reserve ratio in the history at {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio} — so the record cannot say which products are losing demand or how much of the purchase commitments they cover.

anomalies.name: Release's average DSO sits above the period-end DSO
anomalies.name_ko: 실적 발표의 평균 회전일수가 기말 기준보다 높음
anomalies.what: The release's 'Average days' sales outstanding (DSOs) were 71.' sits above the trend table's period-end {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding} and the trailing average-balance {ratios.efficiency.days_sales_outstanding}. Different methods; the release's is not in my inputs, so no reconciliation. All three point the same way as MD&A's 'improved cash collections'.

anomalies.name: Purchase commitments large against inventory and cost of revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 재고·매출원가 대비 과도한 구매약정
anomalies.what: Commitments of {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations} against net inventory of {terms.balances_now.inventory} and trailing cost of revenue of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}; a year earlier {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}. Guided revenue growth and rising backlog argue the orders are needed; the same filing's 'reductions in forecasted demand for certain products' argues some may not be. Purchase commitments in excess of need would surface as the next reserve.

anomalies.name: Two cloud providers carry a third of quarterly revenue
anomalies.name_ko: 두 클라우드 고객이 분기 매출의 삼분의 일을 차지
anomalies.what: 'Two customers represented 10%-plus of revenue for a total of 34.0% of revenue.' Both are cloud providers; the service provider that was a ten-percent customer is 'n/a*' for fiscal 2026. Receivable-concentration facts at fiscal year-end put the largest customer at {concentration.facts.2} against {concentration.facts.0} a year earlier and the second at {concentration.facts.3} against {concentration.facts.1}. Concentrated receivables also make the allowance ratio a poor guide to credit risk.

anomalies.name: Finished goods built while demand-driven provisions rise
anomalies.name_ko: 수요 감소 충당금 증가 속 완제품 재고 확대
anomalies.what: MD&A: 'increased finished good inventory to mitigate supply chain volatility, partially offset by reduction in raw materials'. The note: provision 'primarily driven by reductions in forecasted demand for certain products'. Gross inventory rose and net inventory fell per the numbers reader; days of inventory is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_of_inventory}, the lowest of six quarters, and the six-month cash-flow inventory line shows an increase of {terms.trailing_four_quarters.change_in_inventory.parts.this_year_to_date}. Building finished goods while reserving for demand loss is a mix risk: the finished goods must be the products in demand.

anomalies.name: Long-term investments rise; composition not in the record
anomalies.name_ko: 장기투자 증가, 구성 내역은 기록에 없음
anomalies.what: The 8-K balance sheet prints long-term investments up sharply over the half-year per the numbers reader. The notes reader lists an available-for-sale securities table, which points to marketable debt securities rather than an equity stake in a customer, and no investment in a customer is described. Nothing found on circular or vendor-financed deals; the composition is not in my inputs.

anomalies.name: No channel-stuffing signature in the receivable and deferred-revenue numbers
anomalies.name_ko: 채널 스터핑 징후 없음
anomalies.what: Receivables over quarterly revenue is {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.receivables_over_revenue}, lowest of six quarters; period-end DSO {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}; contract liabilities {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities} against {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities}; backlog rising. None of the stuffing signatures is present. The one item where revenue runs ahead of billing is the long-term unbilled software-licence receivable, unsized.

adjustments.name: accounts payable build from supplier payment timing
adjustments.quote: The change in accounts payable, accruals, and other obligations primarily reflects the timing of payments associated with our annual incentive compensation plan, partially offset by the timing of payments to suppliers

summary_ko.earnings_versus_cash: 최근 네 분기 기준 영업현금흐름/순이익은 {earnings_versus_cash.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, 발생액/평균자산은 {earnings_versus_cash.accruals_over_average_assets}로 이익이 현금으로 뒷받침되며, 과거 두 해({earnings_versus_cash.history.years.0.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income}, {earnings_versus_cash.history.years.1.operating_cash_flow_over_net_income})보다 비율이 낮아진 것은 순이익이 급증했기 때문입니다. 다만 매출이 {ratios.growth.revenue.trailing_four_quarters|pct} 늘어나는 동안 매입채무가 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.balance_sheet_change} 증가해 순이익의 {earnings_versus_cash.working_capital.accounts_payable.share_of_net_income|pct}에 해당하는 현금을 공급했고, 회사는 이를 공급업체 지급 시점의 영향으로 설명하므로 반복되지 않을 수 있습니다.
summary_ko.revenue_recognition: 기말 매출채권 회전일수는 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.days_sales_outstanding}일로 여섯 분기 중 가장 낮고 이연수익 잔액도 {terms.balances_now.contract_liabilities}로 전년({terms.balances_a_year_earlier.contract_liabilities})보다 늘어 매출을 앞당겨 인식한 흔적은 없습니다. 다만 소프트웨어 라이선스를 청구 전에 매출로 인식하는 장기 미청구 매출채권이 새로 공시되었고, '기간에 걸쳐 이전되는 제품 및 서비스' 행이 설명 없이 '서비스'로 바뀌었으며, 수주잔고 전환 시점 문구가 느슨해졌습니다.
summary_ko.estimates_and_reserves: 재고 평가충당금 비율은 {trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.inventory_reserve_ratio}로 공시 이력상 최고치이고 보증충당부채도 쌓이고 있어 충당금을 줄여 이익을 부풀린 흔적은 없습니다. 반면 실효세율은 {tax_rate.effective_rate|pct}로 낮고 회사는 주식보상 세금혜택과 지역 믹스를 이유로 들며, Blue Planet 부문은 손실로 돌아섰는데도 배분된 영업권에 대한 손상 논의가 없습니다.
summary_ko.cost_deferral: 개발비 자본화 태그가 없고 연구개발비 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.research_and_development_expense.parts.this_year_to_date}는 전액 비용 처리된 것으로 보이며 무형·기타자산 비중({trend_table.quarters-back-0.ratios.soft_asset_share})도 크게 오르지 않았습니다. 다만 설비투자가 반기 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.this_year_to_date}로 전년 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.capital_expenditure.parts.prior_year_to_date}보다 크게 늘었고, '일회성'이라는 Nubis 홀드백 보상과 매 기간 반복되는 구조조정비가 조정 실적에서 제외됩니다.
summary_ko.cash_flow_engineering_and_off_balance_sh: 매출채권 매각이나 공급망금융 프로그램은 기록에 없습니다. 반면 구매약정이 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}로 전년 {terms.balances_a_year_earlier.unconditional_purchase_obligations}에서 급증했고 취소 가능 비중을 주석과 MD&A가 반대로 서술하며, 주식보상 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.share_based_compensation}은 실제 비용으로 품질조정 잉여현금흐름 {free_cash_flow.free_cash_flow_quality_adjusted}에 이미 차감되어 있습니다.
summary_ko.controls_audit_and_filing_signals: 감사인 교체, 중요한 취약점, 지연 공시, 정정 공시, 재무책임자 이탈은 없습니다. 작은 신호로는 전년 동기 주식보상 금액이 10-Q와 8-K에서 다르고, 대손충당금 태그가 연간과 분기에서 다르며, 전 분기에 공시된 관세 환급 관련 내용이 이번 분기에는 사라졌고, CFO가 주식 매도 계획을 채택했습니다.
summary_ko.cross_document_reconciliation: 방향이 있는 주석 항목 스물한 개 중 열여섯 개는 숫자가 확인하고 다섯 개는 해당 수준의 숫자가 없어 미확정이며 반박되는 항목은 없습니다. 8-K와 10-Q는 전년 동기 주식보상 한 항목만 빼고 일치하지만, 세율 설명(주석은 주식보상 혜택, MD&A는 세전이익 증가)과 구매약정의 취소 가능 비중은 문서 간 서술이 어긋납니다.
summary_ko.industry_lens: 재고 진부화는 숨기지 않고 인식 중이며(반기 평가손 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.inventory_write_down.parts.this_year_to_date}), 채널 스터핑이나 고객 대상 순환 거래의 징후는 없습니다. 다만 구매약정 {terms.balances_now.unconditional_purchase_obligations}이 재고 {terms.balances_now.inventory}와 연간 매출원가 {terms.trailing_four_quarters.cost_of_revenue}에 비해 크고, 두 클라우드 고객이 분기 매출의 삼분의 일 이상을 차지하며, '특정 제품의 예상 수요 감소'라는 충당금 사유가 '전례 없는 수요' 서술과 맞서 있습니다.

limits: This analysis finds where the numbers and the explanations disagree, and where the company differs from its own past. It does not judge intent, and it cannot see evidence outside the filings, such as invoices or contracts.
